title: Fox $p$-Colorings as Fixed Points of Braid Representations
summary: Fox $p$-colorings of knots and links admit a linear-algebraic description in terms of braid representations. For each braid $β\in B_n$ we associate a representation $M : B_n \to \mathrm{GL}(n,\mathbb{F}_p)$ such that Fox $p$-colorings of the closed braid $\widehatβ$ correspond to fixed points of $M(β)$. As a consequence, $$ \mathrm{Col}_p(\widehatβ) = p^{\dim \ker(M(β)-I)}, $$ yielding an explicit formula for the number of Fox $p$-colorings of arbitrary knots and links. We apply the method to torus links and spiral links, obtaining explicit descriptions of their Fox 3-coloring spaces.
